name: Tatsumi Ichise
source:
26 years old.

A young man who works part time as a jester at the amusement park, “Hell Mansion.” He used to be an actor, but had to leave the spotlight due to a car accident. Hides his scars with makeup.

[From [url=https://www.aksysgames.com/tengoku/characters/ichise/]Aksys Games[/url]]
